title: Papuma document diff (wire format)
description: A policy-applied, field-level diff keyed by dot-separated JSON path. See docs/spec/changes.md.

propertyNames.description: Dot-separated path; no empty segments. Object keys that themselves contain '.' cannot be represented and are rejected when the diff is computed.

tracked.description: Values recorded verbatim. Key presence encodes field existence; the value may be JSON null.

redacted.description: Redact policy: the field changed, values withheld.

reference.description: Reference policy: pointer to the value's location, no value.

hashed.description: Hash policy: change marker plus a hash of the new value; 'hash' is absent when the field was removed.
